Frequently asked questions

g.text: Frequently asked questions

text.id: Everything people ask before getting sta…

g.text: Everything people ask before getting started.

text.id: Can I use this in a commercial project?

g.text: Can I use this in a commercial project?

text.id: Yes. Everything here is yours to ship in…

g.text: Yes. Everything here is yours to ship in client work and paid products, with no attribution required.

text.id: Do I need a specific framework?

g.text: Do I need a specific framework?

text.id: No. The markup is plain HTML and the sty…

g.text: No. The markup is plain HTML and the styling is utility classes, so it drops into any stack that can

text.id: render an element.

g.text: render an element.

text.id: How do updates work?

g.text: How do updates work?

text.id: Copied code is yours — nothing reaches b…

g.text: Copied code is yours — nothing reaches back into your project. Pull a newer version whenever you

text.id: want it.

g.text: want it.

text.id: Is there a free tier?

g.text: Is there a free tier?

text.id: There is. A large part of the catalog is…

g.text: There is. A large part of the catalog is free forever; the paid plan unlocks the rest and removes usage
limits.

Questions, answered

g.text: Questions, answered

text.id: The things people ask before they buy — …

g.text: The things people ask before they buy — and a

text.id: way to ask the ones that are not here.

g.text: way to ask the ones that are not here.

g.text: Still not sure?

g.text: Send the question. A person reads it, and you

text.id: Ask a question

g.text: Ask a question

text.id: What happens when my licence expires?

g.text: What happens when my licence expires?

text.id: Nothing stops working. What ends is acce…

g.text: Nothing stops working. What ends is access to components published after your window —

text.id: everything you already copied stays your…

g.text: everything you already copied stays yours to ship, permanently, with no check at runtime.

text.id: Can I use this for client work?

g.text: Can I use this for client work?

text.id: Yes, on any paid plan, including project…

g.text: Yes, on any paid plan, including projects you hand over to the client afterwards. The one thing

text.id: no licence covers is reselling the compo…

g.text: no licence covers is reselling the components themselves as a competing library.

text.id: Do I need to credit you?

g.text: Do I need to credit you?

text.id: No. Attribution is never required, on an…

g.text: No. Attribution is never required, on any plan, including the free one.

text.id: Is there a team plan?

g.text: Is there a team plan?

text.id: There is, priced per seat, with shared b…

g.text: There is, priced per seat, with shared brand tokens and one workspace everybody pulls from. It

text.id: can be billed monthly or bought outright…

g.text: can be billed monthly or bought outright for a year.

text.id: What if I need something that is not in …

g.text: What if I need something that is not in the catalog?

text.id: Ask. Requests that several people want a…

g.text: Ask. Requests that several people want are usually the next thing built, and the roadmap is
public.

Common questions

g.text: Common questions

text.id: Short answers, all of them on the page.

g.text: Short answers, all of them on the page.

text.id: Is there a free plan?

g.text: Is there a free plan?

text.id: Yes, and it is not a trial. Browsing, cu…

g.text: Yes, and it is not a trial. Browsing, customising and copying stay free

text.id: permanently — what a paid licence buys i…

g.text: permanently — what a paid licence buys is the right to ship the result
commercially.

text.id: Which frameworks are supported?

g.text: Which frameworks are supported?

text.id: The effects are CSS-first and work anywh…

g.text: The effects are CSS-first and work anywhere that renders an element.

text.id: The blocks, pages and templates are Reac…

g.text: The blocks, pages and templates are React and Tailwind.

text.id: Do I need an account to copy code?

g.text: Do I need an account to copy code?

text.id: No. Every artifact is readable and copya…

g.text: No. Every artifact is readable and copyable without signing in, and the

text.id: public API needs no key.

g.text: public API needs no key.

text.id: How do updates reach my project?

g.text: How do updates reach my project?

text.id: They do not, by design. Copied code is y…

g.text: They do not, by design. Copied code is yours and nothing reaches back

text.id: into your repository — you pull a newer …

g.text: into your repository — you pull a newer version when you actually want
one.

text.id: Can I customise before copying?

g.text: Can I customise before copying?

text.id: Yes. Colours, timing and sizing are edit…

g.text: Yes. Colours, timing and sizing are editable in the browser, and what you

text.id: copy is what you configured.

g.text: copy is what you configured.

text.id: What about accessibility?

g.text: What about accessibility?

text.id: Components ship with real semantics and …

g.text: Components ship with real semantics and honour prefers-reduced-

text.id: motion. Anything decorative that animate…

g.text: motion. Anything decorative that animates is gated so it does not run for

text.id: visitors who have asked for less motion.

g.text: visitors who have asked for less motion.

text.id: Billing 2

g.text: Billing

text.id: Can I change plans mid-cycle?

g.text: Can I change plans mid-cycle?

text.id: Yes, and the change takes effect immedia…

g.text: Yes, and the change takes effect immediately. Upgrades are prorated to the day;

text.id: downgrades credit the unused remainder a…

g.text: downgrades credit the unused remainder against your next invoice rather than

text.id: refunding it.

g.text: refunding it.

text.id: What happens if a payment fails?

g.text: What happens if a payment fails?

text.id: We retry on days 1, 3 and 7 and email yo…

g.text: We retry on days 1, 3 and 7 and email you each time. Nothing is suspended until the

text.id: fourth failure, and your data is retaine…

g.text: fourth failure, and your data is retained for 30 days after that.

text.id: Do you offer annual invoicing?

g.text: Do you offer annual invoicing?

text.id: On any plan, and it is the only option o…

g.text: On any plan, and it is the only option on Enterprise. Annual terms are billed once, so

text.id: there is no recurring charge that can fa…

g.text: there is no recurring charge that can fail — which matters if your cards decline cross-

text.id: border subscriptions.

g.text: border subscriptions.

text.id: Security 2

g.text: Security

text.id: Where is our data stored?

g.text: Where is our data stored?

text.id: In the region you pick at workspace crea…

g.text: In the region you pick at workspace creation: Virginia, Frankfurt or Sydney. It does not

text.id: leave that region, including for backups…

g.text: leave that region, including for backups, and the region cannot be changed later without

text.id: a migration we run for you.

g.text: a migration we run for you.

text.id: Are you SOC 2 compliant?

g.text: Are you SOC 2 compliant?

text.id: Type II, audited annually. The current r…

g.text: Type II, audited annually. The current report is available under NDA from the security

text.id: page, along with our penetration test su…

g.text: page, along with our penetration test summary.

text.id: Can we bring our own encryption keys?

g.text: Can we bring our own encryption keys?

text.id: On Enterprise, via AWS KMS or Google Clo…

g.text: On Enterprise, via AWS KMS or Google Cloud KMS. Revoking the key makes the

text.id: workspace unreadable to us within minute…

g.text: workspace unreadable to us within minutes.

text.id: Integrations 2

g.text: Integrations

text.id: Does it work with our existing helpdesk?

g.text: Does it work with our existing helpdesk?

text.id: There are first-party integrations for Z…

g.text: There are first-party integrations for Zendesk, Intercom, Front and Help Scout, and a

text.id: webhook plus REST API for anything else.…

g.text: webhook plus REST API for anything else. Most teams run alongside their helpdesk for

text.id: the first month rather than replacing it…

g.text: the first month rather than replacing it.

text.id: Is there an API rate limit?

g.text: Is there an API rate limit?

text.id: 600 requests a minute per workspace on p…

g.text: 600 requests a minute per workspace on paid plans, 60 on trials. Limits are per

text.id: workspace rather than per key, so adding…

g.text: workspace rather than per key, so adding keys does not add capacity.
